profile.headline: Code Person
profile.summary: Experienced Engineering Manager and Full Stack Developer with a history of effective collaboration, a commitment to open communication, and outstanding software.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Converted the older Django storefront to a React app consuming RESTful APIs. Responsible for implementing coding best practices, including writing Front End tests and documentation that improved the quality of the codebase. Reduced page load time by optimizing database queries and inefficient React and Django code. Created and maintained architecture decision records to help communicate technical solutions to stakeholders. Architected and implemented a change to ElasticSearch reindex process, resulting in a no-downtime process and increasing app availability. Mentored junior engineers utilizing pair programming and thoughtful pull request feedback to help develop their skills.
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JavaScript · Linux · Elasticsearch · Django · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · SQL · Python (Programming Language) · React.js

positions.title: Engineering Manager
positions.description: Coordinated company project requirements with 10+ other engineering teams. Delivered a new Asset Management system utilizing a React/Redux Front End with a Spring Boot REST API. Helped stabilize test suite for monolith PHP app and k8s infrastructure. Reduced monolith Front End app test suite run time, resulting in a more efficient testing process.
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · JavaScript · Linux · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · PHP · SQL · React.js

positions.title: Engineering Lead
positions.description: Responsible for mentoring/managing engineers, architecting solutions, and reviewing/writing code. Led efforts to increase application security and PCI compliance, upgrade application to the latest Rails version, and improved performance. Integrated React Front End and GraphQL backend with a focus on reducing payload sizes and CPU/Memory usage.
positions.insights: Skills: Kubernetes · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Ruby · JavaScript · Linux · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Prometheus.io · SQL · Grafana · React.js · GraphQL

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: Managed teams responsible for Mobile Wallet/Coupon/Loyalty app and legacy monolith SMS/MMS marketing campaigns application processing millions of messages per day. Successfully led the effort to migrate applications from colocated servers to AWS, resulting in improved scalability, reliability, and security. Internationalized application and led effort to deploy the app multi-region in EU and Asia, increasing product reach. Converted team to a Kanban process to reduce cognitive workload and deliver faster. During developer 20% time, built a Node.js/Express.js websocket display app and a Rails app for managing Google and Apple Wallet cards. These apps became major parts of the product offering, generating millions in revenue per year.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Ruby · JavaScript · Linux · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · SQL · React.js

positions.description: Lead Front End developer for Tribune Social Registration and Single Sign On Project.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby · JavaScript · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · SQL

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description: End to End Developer for multiple projects mostly in ColdFusion and PHP on the Back End and jQuery on the Front End.
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · PHP · SQL
